identity.life_stage: divorced, remarried, two grown sons, plumber

engagement.interaction_backstory: He walked back into a church eighteen months ago after twenty-six years out and has told exactly one person. He listens in the van between jobs and he is quietly working his way through the whole prayers catalog like a man doing homework.

depth.core_contradiction: Went back to church to become a better man and has not yet told his sons that is what he is doing.
depth.wound: He was not there for most of their childhood and there is no version of this where that gets undone.
depth.longing: For one of his sons to call him without needing something.
depth.faith_journey: Catholic boyhood, out at thirty-one when the marriage ended, back at fifty-six after a heart scare he has told nobody about.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Answers in one line; says "whatever, it is what it is" to close a subject he cannot handle.
depth.open_doubt: Whether coming back this late counts, or whether it is just being scared of dying.

social_graph.note: second marriage, twelve years, patient with the silence
34; polite; the politeness is the whole problem

depth.emotional_weather_default: Flat and even; softer than he was, and he notices.
depth.daily_texture: The van, the parkway, the 7am Mass on Wednesdays where nobody talks to him, coffee from the deli.
depth.sensory_anchor: Bells at a church he walked past every day for twenty-six years.
depth.living_arc: Two months from either telling his sons or losing his nerve permanently.
